reuseByReference.reused: Harness-neutral acceptance rules: outcome vocabulary (unexecuted/pass/fail/blocked/unknown/unsupported), denominator retention, native-test evidence rules, settled-ordinary vs unresolved vs policy/fatal classification semantics per #89/850(a)/(b)/(c) as amended by #93, usage/authority rules, binding and review rules. Not duplicated or forked here; this contract adds only Claude-Code-specific argv/env/auth/discovery/event/role/stream bindings.

The proposed-action final schema is harness-neutral and is reused by reference as the full protected schema against which result.structured_output is always re-validated by the host. This contract ships no second schema file. #111 amendment (wire projection): the --json-schema wire value is a deterministic projection of these frozen bytes — canonical-minified, with ONLY "$schema" replaced by "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#" (explicit dialect, never omission) — because the pinned claude 2.1.283 --json-schema validator lacks the draft-2020-12 meta-schema in its bundled registry and rejects the frozen IRI at startup (exit 1, 'no schema with key or ref', zero frames), while the same body under the draft-07 IRI is accepted and proceeds to auth failure (source: R1 #108 CC-P5 verdict + diag-json-schema zero-turn diagnostic, .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P5/). The frozen body uses no draft-2020-12-exclusive vocabulary (only $schema/$id/title/type/properties/required/additionalProperties/const/enum/minLength/maxLength/pattern), so the draft-07 reading is semantically identical. Host-side validation authority remains these frozen 2020-12 bytes, unchanged; the projection is derived at launch preparation, is fail-closed unless the source "$schema" is exactly the frozen 2020-12 IRI, and its projection hash (sha256 c02efee93dbeffb0e6f6153ba6d465804af4f31cb163d95ab76fe9f4b5b1a6e3 of the projected canonical bytes) is pinned with the launch bundle.

Budget mode subscription-observed-v1, harness-reported usage schema 2 with statuses reported/ambiguous-zero/unknown, planning charges, threshold and recovery_required stop semantics. This contract only defines the Claude Code adapter mapping onto those semantics; it does not restate or fork them.

Accepted duplex semantics: durable attempted-before-IO intent, write-once, single EOF, no resend after ambiguity, immutable-before-start bundle. Claude-Code-specific evidence-of-consumption (system/init) is added below; the durable-intent semantics themselves are referenced, not forked.

candidate.binaryKind: native Bun single-file Mach-O; the only inspectable 'source' is the embedded minified bundle (strings/minified-JS readings). Bundle strings are not runtime proof and not a reproducible build (source: #94/872 F1 [B])
candidate.binaryIdentityProvenance: #94/872 F1, host-measured sha256/size/VERSION/BUILD_TIME; never taken from `claude --version`
candidate.spawnPathRule: Always spawn the absolute versioned path. The ~/.local/bin/claude symlink moves on auto-update, so it is never a spawn target; the hash is re-measured at admission checkpoint C1 and a missing or changed binary makes the profile unavailable, never substituted (source: #94/872 F1; #94/880 G-VERSION)

forbiddenAlternateBinaries.reason: predates --permission-prompts (2.1.259+) and AGENTS.md reading (2.1.277+); must never be used (source: #94/872 F1)
other installed versions; not the pinned candidate (source: #94/872 F1)
symlink that moves on auto-update (source: #94/872 F1)

candidate.changelogCorroboration: GitHub anthropics/claude-code main CHANGELOG.md top entry '## 2.1.283' (source: #94/872 Sources)

launch.spawn: absolute versioned binary path, detached process group, stdio pipe x3; implementer cwd=SRC, reviewer cwd=SRC (source: #94/878 section A)
launch.argvSerialization: Commander variadic options (--tools, --allowedTools, --disallowedTools, --add-dir, --mcp-config) swallow following args, so EVERY option is exactly one argv element in --opt=value form; a would-be positional after --tools must never become a tool (source: #94/878 section A [B option defs]; #94/880 FK2)
argvTemplateNotes: No positional prompt; the prompt comes on stdin (source: #94/878 section A).
--verbose is mandatory: with -p, stream-json without --verbose exits 1 with 'Error: When using --print, --output-format=stream-json requires --verbose' (source: #94/879 F14 [B]).
--setting-sources= is present as an EMPTY value; the empty string yields [] and an unknown value is an error (source: #94/872 F6 [B]).
Reviewer role additionally passes --restricted; that it composes with explicit --tools/--setting-sources= is an open probe (source: #94/878 section A [D; P]; #94/880 G-INIT-VALUES).

The default Anthropic system prompt is NOT replaced: --system-prompt/--system-prompt-file stay on the never-pass list and only --append-system-prompt-file is used, so the default prompt is bound solely by the version pin (source: #94/878 section A; #94/880 G-DEFAULT-PROMPT; decision D-06).

--json-schema carries the WIRE PROJECTION of the frozen request schema (#111 amendment): canonical-minified acceptance/subscription/final.schema.json bytes with only "$schema" replaced by "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#". Pinned 2.1.283 rejects the frozen draft-2020-12 $schema at startup ('no schema with key or ref', exit 1, zero frames) and accepts the same body under draft-07 (source: R1 #108 CC-P5 + zero-turn draft-isolation diagnostic). The producer fail-closes if the source "$schema" is not exactly the frozen 2020-12 IRI or the projection derivation is non-deterministic; the projection hash is pinned (sha256 c02efee93dbeffb0e6f6153ba6d465804af4f31cb163d95ab76fe9f4b5b1a6e3); host-side final validation still uses the FROZEN 2020-12 schema bytes as its unchanged authority.

profile.reason: Source/doc-valid template from #94 research only. G-KC (model-reachable keychain credential for the shell-bearing implementer) is DECIDED: risk accepted by the user 2026-09-28 (#95/883, #1/884) and carried as an explicit user-accepted limitation (decision D-15), so this profile no longer waits on it. G-SET (silently ignored invalid settings), G-MANAGED, G-HOME, G-INIT-VALUES and the exact role model table remain open; native and live evidence require separately granted authority. No guessed keys or inherited entries.

implementer.notes: SRC write through Edit/Write inside cwd; Bash sandboxed with writes to cwd=SRC and SCR only, no network. The G-KC keychain exposure applies to this role — Bash may reach the subscription keychain item through the Seatbelt-allowed SecurityServer/securityd.xpc mach services — and is carried as an explicit user-accepted limitation (risk accepted 2026-09-28, #95/883, #1/884; decision D-15), not as a contained path (source: #94/878 section D; #94/872 F5).

reviewer.notes: No shell, which removes the G-KC path from the reviewer. Edit/Write absent from --tools so any file write is impossible by tool absence [P roster]; confined to cwd by blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories and --restricted. A reviewer --add-dir is never granted; --add-dir dirs are sandbox-writable so a read-only-source-plus-scratch design via --add-dir is NOT source-valid (source: #94/878 section D).

roleProfiles.bothRoles: no MCP, hooks, plugins, skills, subagents, web, memory, background tasks or instruction files except the approved append prompt plus the unavoidable version-bound Claude Code default system prompt (source: #94/878 section D)

neverPassFlags: --safe-mode (unverified interaction with Rocky settings semantics; excluded)
--add-dir (not needed; the reviewer must never get one)
--max-budget-usd (a client estimate, not a subscription control)

models.rule: Model and effort come ONLY from an approved role table frozen in run config; the producer validates --effort against low|medium|high|xhigh|max because an unknown value only prints a stderr warning and silently uses the default. init does not echo effort, so effort is requested-only. The served model ID is read from result.modelUsage keys and assistant.message.model, never assumed (source: #94/878 F11, section A). The warn-only off-table effort behavior is natively confirmed zero-turn (R1 #108 CC-P2 e, PASS: exact stderr "Warning: Unknown --effort value 'bogus' — ignoring it and using the default effort." then proceed to auth failure), so the producer-rejection duty (claude-effort-off-table) is CONFIRMED load-bearing; a finite candidate-ID enumeration for the host-frozen role table now exists but is bundle strings only, NOT runtime-attested (R1 #108 CC-P8: 99 refined candidates; see G-MODEL) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P2/verdict.md, CC-P8/verdict.md; #110/R3).
models.researchExample: claude-opus-5-5/high for complex implementation or independent review (source: #94/878 section A, which requests the exact full model ID from #95/#90 role tables; research did not pin one)
models.noFallback: --fallback-model and the fallbackModel setting reroute silently and are forbidden; managed availableModels can constrain --model and is an inventory item; a modelUsage key different from the requested model is fatal (source: #94/878 F11; #94/879 FATAL class)

input.kind: one-shot raw UTF-8 on stdin; no prompt in argv
input.maxBytes: <= min(config, 10 MB); over the cap the run errors with a nonzero exit
rejectBeforeSpawn: empty input ('Input must be provided...' exit 1)
input.consumptionEvidence: Prompt consumption is evidenced only by system/init: the empty/whitespace checks run before init is emitted, so init means the prompt was accepted [P]. If the child exits before reading (EPIPE or silent buffering), the attempt stays attempted-unknown: no init, no resend, no success (source: #94/878 F12, section E; #94/880 FK4). Durable attempted-before-IO intent, write-once and single-EOF semantics are reused by reference from the accepted subscription duplex contract (acceptance/subscription/manifest.json launch.input; #92 F9 analogue).
input.inputFormatNote: --input-format stream-json would need stdin open for the whole session and is not used; --input-format=text is pinned (source: #94/878 F12).

environment.policy: sealed POSITIVE allowlist, exact immutable bytes, nothing inherited; ordered [key,value] list equal to the approved bundle (source: #94/878 section C)

allowlist.HOME: <PH> fresh per-action parent home (dedicated mode H1; canonical realpath, 0700)
allowlist.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: <CFG> dedicated Rocky config dir; REQUIRED in dedicated mode and FORBIDDEN in shared mode; even the literal ~/.claude path selects a different keychain entry, so the user's existing login is not found under a Rocky CFG (source: #94/872 F4)
allowlist.conditional: SHELL=/bin/zsh, USER or LOGNAME only if a native probe shows they are needed; USER affects the keychain account name, so its value must be the real login name (source: #94/878 section C [B wk()]; #94/880 G-HOME)

environment.forbiddenRationale: In -p, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is ALWAYS used when present, with no approval, and it plus ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, provider switches, apiKeyHelper, profiles/federation and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL outrank subscription OAuth, so any of them leaking into the child silently switches billing away from the subscription. CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1/--bare is strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-or-apiKeyHelper auth and is incompatible with subscription; CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN would mean Rocky holds a token. CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB is forbidden because it disables sandbox auto-allow. Regression-asserted always-absent (source: #94/872 F2/F3; #94/878 section C; #94/880 FK3).

settings.role: the ONLY settings source besides unavoidable managed layers; passed via --settings with --setting-sources= empty so user/project/local layers are excluded (source: #94/878 section B)
settings.templateProvenance: source: #94/878 section B [D keys unless noted]
prohibitedKeysRejectedByProducer: permissions.allow entries beyond the role table
settings.silentIgnoreWarning: In -p, settings files that fail validation are SILENTLY IGNORED, so an invalid Rocky --settings file could silently disable the sandbox; the settings bytes are canonical, round-trip parsed with duplicate-key rejection and hash-bound before spawn, and gate G-SET requires a native proof plus a per-run positive-control strategy before the profile is admissible (source: #94/872 F6; #94/880 G-SET, NP4). The silent-ignore DIRECTION now has its native zero-turn proof (R1 #108 CC-P3, PASS): invalid --settings (unknown key; malformed JSON) is silently ignored — byte-identical auth-failure frames to the valid baseline (Direction B) — so the shipped fail-closed validateClaudeSettingsBytes pre-spawn validation is evidence-bound mandatory; the per-run positive-control/effectiveness half of G-SET still requires CC-L2 (LIVE, NOT run) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P3/verdict.md; #110/R3).
settings.unresolvedSandboxScope: sandbox.network scope conflicts across docs ('User or managed' vs 'user, managed, or CLI --settings') and stays [P] until probed (source: #94/878 F9 sandbox bullets).

discovery.settingsLayers: Precedence managed > CLI --settings > local > project > user; deny beats allow across all layers. --setting-sources takes a comma list of user,project,local and the empty value yields []; exclusion drops each layer's settings.json, CLAUDE.md/rules, skills/commands/agents, local md, sandbox.filesystem entries and project/local credentials (source: #94/872 F6).
notControlledBySettingSources: endpoint managed policy (/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/{managed-settings.json, managed-settings.d/*.json, managed-mcp.json, CLAUDE.md}, MDM domain com.anthropic.claudecode)
server-managed settings (fetched for Team/Enterprise OAuth or direct API key, cached at <configDir>/remote-settings.json)
discovery.managedPolicy: Managed layers cannot be disabled and a managed env block can select a provider, so ANY present managed/MDM/server-managed cache in the discovery inventory makes the profile unavailable until separately reviewed; the inventory is rehashed each run and drift makes the result unknown (source: #94/872 F6; #94/879 producer contract 1; #94/880 G-MANAGED, FK8).
discovery.instructionSources: managed CLAUDE.md (cannot be excluded); ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and rules; project CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules for cwd and every ancestor; CLAUDE.local.md; AGENTS.md (2.1.277+); @imports up to 4 hops; subdirectory CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md on demand; auto memory <configDir>/projects/<proj>/memory/MEMORY.md is loaded AND writable by the model even under managed-only (source: #94/872 F7).
discovery.instructionControls: --setting-sources= empty; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS=1 (covers user, project and auto memory; managed unclear, gate G-CLAUDEMD-MANAGED); CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 plus autoMemoryEnabled:false; and a staged tree with no CLAUDE*.md, AGENTS.md or .claude in the tree or ANY ancestor (source: #94/872 F7).

otherRoutes.hooks: --settings disableAllHooks:true; managed hooks and allowManagedHooksOnly are inventory items (source: #94/872 F8)
otherRoutes.skills: --disable-slash-commands ('Disable all skills' [B]), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS=1, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS=1, Skill omitted from --tools and denied (source: #94/872 F8)
otherRoutes.subagents: Agent/Workflow omitted from --tools and denied; CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS=1 [D only] (source: #94/872 F8)
otherRoutes.mcp: --strict-mcp-config with no --mcp-config removes all MCP including claude.ai connectors, which otherwise load automatically with a claude.ai login; disableClaudeAiConnectors:true added; a managed-mcp.json applies regardless and is an inventory item (source: #94/872 F8)
otherRoutes.plugins: come from settings layers and --plugin-dir, both excluded (source: #94/872 F8)
otherRoutes.backgroundTasks: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1; without it -p waits up to 10 minutes for background subagents and kills background shells 5 s after the result (source: #94/872 F8)

auth.mode: subscription OAuth from the pinned candidate's own /login is the ONLY auth; no separate API credential, token proxy or gateway (source: #94/872 F2 precedence list, F3)
auth.owner: trusted Claude Code parent; Rocky never reads, copies, symlinks or proxies credentials or tokens
auth.home: dedicated mode H1 only: HOME=<PH> with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<CFG>, a Rocky-dedicated config dir in which the user once runs an interactive /login. This gets its own keychain entry 'Claude Code-credentials-<sha8(CFG)>' and its own refresh, and shares no user settings, CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins or MCP. Shared mode H2 is rejected by this contract because of gate G-RACE (source: #94/872 F4; #94/878 section C; decision D-04).
auth.credentialStorage: macOS login-keychain generic password, service 'Claude Code' + OAUTH_FILE_SUFFIX + '-credentials' (suffixed by config dir hash when CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is set); account $USER validated against ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$; fallback file <configDir>/.credentials.json (0600) when the keychain rejects the write. Rocky derives the service name only as a nonsecret identifier and makes NO keychain call (source: #94/872 F4 [D+B]).
auth.incompatibleAuthModes: --bare / CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE=1 (strictly ANTHROPIC_API_KEY-or-apiKeyHelper, OAuth and keychain never read) and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (Rocky would hold a token) are rejected before spawn (source: #94/872 F3).
auth.postHocNonsecretSignals: init.apiKeySource must be 'none' and every result.modelUsage[*].provider must be 'firstParty'. 'none' does NOT distinguish subscription OAuth from a bearer token or a profile, so the sealed environment and settings, not this signal, carry the exclusivity proof (source: #94/872 F2 signals).
auth.acceptedLimitationGKC: USER-ACCEPTED LIMITATION, risk ACCEPTED by the user 2026-09-28 (#95/883, mirrored #1/884). Exposure fact: the Seatbelt profile for sandboxed Bash allows mach-lookup of com.apple.SecurityServer and com.apple.securityd.xpc, the sandbox default read scope is the whole disk with no built-in credential deny list, and Bash deny rules are bypassable by path/sh -c/scripts, so a model-run `security find-generic-password -w -s 'Claude Code-credentials...'` MAY return the subscription OAuth tokens without a prompt; unproven either way [P]. This is recorded as an explicit, user-accepted visible limitation for the final report — NOT a qualified containment claim; the contract makes no claim that the sandbox denies this path. Accepted-decision terms (#95/883): no separate macOS user account; no sandbox-denial probe required before proceeding (scenario N03 stays available as OPTIONAL defense-in-depth evidence, never a blocking prerequisite); ALL other protections in this section remain required (Rocky never reads/copies/symlinks/proxies credentials, sealed env allowlist, forbidden API envs, --setting-sources= empty, Rocky-owned --settings, dedicated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with one-time user /login, init.apiKeySource/provider post-checks, reviewer role gets no shell); revisit if the deployment moves to a shared/multi-user host. Consequence: the implementer profile no longer waits on G-KC; it remains blocked by its OTHER honest gates (G-SET, G-MANAGED, G-HOME, G-INIT-VALUES, G-MODEL) and separately granted native/live authority (source: #94/872 F5; #94/880 G-KC, NP3; decision D-15; review #96 B-01).

runtimePaths.rule: RUN is a fresh per-action root (canonical realpath, 0700, no .git/CLAUDE*.md/AGENTS.md/.claude in RUN or any ancestor); SRC=RUN/stage/source, SCR=RUN/scratch, PH=RUN/parent/home, PT=RUN/parent/tmp, INP=RUN/inputs (0400 files), CFG=designated dedicated config dir [H]. Paths are absolute, NFC, contain no control chars or glob metachars and no ','. All grants pairwise non-overlapping, none inside configDir, configDir not inside any grant (source: #94/878 Placeholders, producer contract 1).
runtimePaths.persistentWritesNote: --no-session-persistence stops transcripts but the CLI still writes <configDir>/.claude.json and possibly caches, plugin data and file-history; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING=1 stops file-history. What exactly is written despite the flag is open gate G-WRITES, inventoried before/after on the synthetic dir (source: #94/878 F13; #94/880 G-WRITES). R1 #108 CC-P5 ran exactly that synthetic inventory zero-turn: unauth startup gained .claude.json, backups/ and sessions/ inside the synthetic CFG despite both switches; the private synthetic HOME gained none; the write set was inventoried and bounded (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P5/verdict.md). The G-WRITES residual (auth-refresh and LIVE-surface writes) stays open; #110/R3.

immutableBeforeStart: cwd/staged tree and ancestor instruction-file absence
request schema projected canonical wire bytes (draft-07 projection of the frozen 2020-12 schema, #111) and its pinned projection sha256

protocol.kind: fresh claude -p stream-json: newline-delimited JSON objects on stdout; --verbose mandatory with -p stream-json; not external JSON-RPC (source: #94/879 F14)
protocol.messageUnionIsOpen: The documented SDKMessage union is OPEN (36 members); the interpreter requires a reviewed allowlist and an unknown message type/subtype not on it rejects (source: #94/879 F14; classification UNRESOLVED).
events: user (tool_result blocks {tool_use_id, content, is_error} and tool_use_result)
system/permission_denied {tool_name, tool_use_id, decision_reason_type(rule|mode|classifier|asyncAgent), decision_reason, message} (best-effort; skips the PreToolUse-hook path)
protocol.initFields: session_id, apiKeySource, claude_code_version, cwd, tools[], mcp_servers[], model, permissionMode, slash_commands, skills, plugins, plugin_errors?, capabilities? (source: #94/879 F14). Exact expected tools/skills/slash_commands/mcp_servers values under this profile, including whether StructuredOutput appears in tools, are open gate G-INIT-VALUES [P] (source: #94/880).
protocol.assistantFrames: message = BetaMessage {id, model, content[text|thinking|tool_use{id,name,input}], stop_reason, usage}, parent_tool_use_id, error? (authentication_failed|oauth_org_not_allowed|account_on_hold|billing_error|rate_limit|overloaded|invalid_request|model_not_found|server_error|max_output_tokens|cloud_credential_error|unknown), aborted?. One API response can produce several assistant frames sharing message.id (source: #94/879 F14).
protocol.resultFields: subtype success|error_max_turns|error_during_execution|error_max_budget_usd|error_max_structured_output_retries; is_error INDEPENDENT of subtype (success may carry is_error:true with api_error_status); num_turns, duration_ms, duration_api_ms, total_cost_usd (client ESTIMATE), usage (main loop only), modelUsage{model:{inputTokens, outputTokens(includes thinking), thinkingTokens?, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, webSearchRequests, costUSD, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, canonicalModel?, provider?, costBasis?}} (includes subagents, compaction and internal calls), permission_denials[{tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_input}] (the AUTHORITATIVE denial record), structured_output?, stop_reason, terminal_reason? (completed|max_turns|tool_deferred|aborted_streaming|aborted_tools|hook_stopped|stop_hook_prevented|background_requested|blocking_limit|rapid_refill_breaker|prompt_too_long|image_error|model_error|api_error|malformed_tool_use_exhausted|budget_exhausted|structured_output_retry_exhausted|tool_deferred_unavailable|turn_setup_failed), errors[], startup_failure_reason?, result_index?, origin?, queued_turn_count? (absent on crash/fatal-startup results, which may carry zeroed totals). More than one result can occur (task-notification follow-ups); a result_index gap means a lost result (source: #94/879 F15).
protocol.structuredOutput: --json-schema takes an INLINE canonical minified JSON string, not a path; an invalid schema exits with an error; 'format' is annotation-only; an 'unsatisfiable' schema only WARNS to the debug log. It is implemented as a synthetic tool named StructuredOutput appearing as a tool_use/tool_result pair; the value arrives in result.structured_output; failure subtype is error_max_structured_output_retries; success WITHOUT structured_output is possible and must be treated as failure. The host ALWAYS re-validates result.structured_output against the full protected schema (acceptance/subscription/final.schema.json by reference) and against action/input/role; the flag is a request, not evidence (source: #94/878 F10, section F). #111 amendment: the inline value is the wire projection of the frozen schema — canonical-minified, "$schema" replaced by "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#", body semantically identical (no draft-2020-12-exclusive vocabulary present) — because the pinned 2.1.283 validator registry lacks the 2020-12 meta-schema and rejects the frozen IRI at startup while accepting the draft-07 body (source: R1 #108 CC-P5 + zero-turn diagnostic); host re-validation authority remains the frozen 2020-12 bytes and the projection hash is pinned.
successRequires: exactly one system/init first (after no startup events other than known ones), with session_id nonblank, claude_code_version=='2.1.283', cwd==SRC, apiKeySource=='none', mcp_servers==[], plugins==[], skills/slash_commands within the approved (expected empty) set [P exact values, G-INIT-VALUES], tools == the exact role roster (+StructuredOutput where proven), permissionMode=='dontAsk' (source: #94/879 COMPLETE)
every assistant tool_use id unique with exactly one later user tool_result carrying the same tool_use_id
exactly one result: subtype 'success', is_error false, terminal_reason 'completed' if present, structured_output present and valid against the FULL protected schema and bound to action/input/role
permission_denials empty AND no system/permission_denied event
no assistant.error, no aborted:true, no stream frames after result
every modelUsage key == the requested model ID and every provider == 'firstParty'
complete bounded stdout AND stderr EOF, exit 0 and independent owned physical quiescence, recorded separately
unchanged admission identity, no cancellation, original fence/deadline
protocol.exitCodes: After the stream, exit = 1 iff the LAST result has is_error:true or the transport closed permanently, otherwise 0 — INCLUDING exit 0 when NO result was emitted in stream-json mode; argument/validation errors print stderr and exit 1; SIGTERM exits 143, kills the running Bash process tree, and leaves the turn unfinished with NO result; SIGINT 'ends the turn' but its exact frames/exit are unobserved [P, G-SIGINT]; known startup refusals emit an error_during_execution result with startup_failure_reason only when CLAUDE_CODE_STARTUP_FAILURE_RESULTS=1, otherwise stderr plus nonzero exit. Exit code alone is therefore NEVER success evidence (source: #94/879 F16 [B]). R1 #108 zero-turn native observations (#110/R3): (1) neither signal shape is natively observed — CC-P6 ii/iii never delivered the scheduled T+10s SIGTERM / T+8s SIGINT because unauth auth-failure exited in ~250-260 ms first, so the 143-no-result (FK7/F12) and SIGINT shapes stay UNKNOWN-WITH-OBSERVATION pending CC-L3 (LIVE, NOT run); (2) the input-validation refusals (empty stdin, whitespace-only stdin, stream-json without --verbose, invalid --json-schema JSON) exit before startup — no startup_failure_reason frame appeared under CLAUDE_CODE_STARTUP_FAILURE_RESULTS=1 (CC-P2); (3) the unauth auth-failure path surfaces as ONE synthetic assistant frame (model '<synthetic>', is_api_error_message:true, zero usage) plus a result frame carrying subtype:'success' WITH is_error:true and terminal_reason:'api_error' — a subtype-only classifier would misread auth failure as success; the shipped adapter settles this shape fatal correctly (CC-P2/CC-P5; #108 root triage comment 972) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P6/verdict.md, CC-P2/verdict.md, CC-P5/verdict.md).
protocol.cancellation: SIGTERM the owned process group only: exit 143 with no result classifies unknown; detached descendants are killed; EOFs and quiescence are recorded separately; a late result after cancel is ignored; NO interrupt acknowledgement is ever claimed. Cancellation is SIGTERM-only until G-SIGINT is closed by native observation (source: #94/879 producer contract 4 Cancel; #94/880 FK7, G-SIGINT).
protocol.apiRetryDecision: system/api_retry records retried attempts and is not fatal by itself; a run that retries and later completes the full COMPLETE conjunction is ACCEPTED and the retry events are recorded in evidence. This is the #95 decision requested by research (recommendation adopted). A model fallback without --fallback-model remains detectable only through modelUsage keys and stays fatal when observed (source: #94/879 F16 note; #94/880 G-RETRY; decision D-05).
protocol.finalSchema: acceptance/subscription/final.schema.json (reused by reference; sha256 954dd71e11a7b45ac86c9b30d96c9ef98d5fd40e2864568d149dd39c15986792). Host validation authority UNCHANGED by the #111 wire projection: only the --json-schema wire bytes carry the draft-07 $schema replacement (projection sha256 c02efee93dbeffb0e6f6153ba6d465804af4f31cb163d95ab76fe9f4b5b1a6e3); every host re-validation of result.structured_output uses the frozen 2020-12 semantics.
protocol.sourceVisibilityGap: The effective sandbox state is NOT observable in the stream; prompt consumption is evidenced only by system/init; effort is not echoed. Absence of a stream field is not absence of activity: these gaps bind to qualification plus inventory (G-SET, G-INIT-VALUES, G-EFFORT) (source: #94/879 runtime metadata sources 5).
protocol.successMeaning: Protocol-qualified current proposal only; never authoritative checks/review/CI, head adoption or delivery acceptance (reused by reference from acceptance/subscription/README.md 'Usage and authority').

toolOutcomeClasses.settledOrdinaryFailure: A tool_result with is_error:true whose tool_use_id is NOT in result.permission_denials and has no system/permission_denied event is a settled ordinary failure and does not alone reject a later correctly bound proposal: e.g. a nonzero Bash test run, or an Edit old_string mismatch followed by a later corrected Edit with a distinct tool_use_id. Seatbelt violations surface here as ordinary Bash output naming the denied path/host; per #89/850(a) they stay ordinary for protocol purposes and containment rests on the independent protected-state oracle and native qualification, never relabelling. Preserve exact status/output/history (source: #94/879 SETTLED ORDINARY FAILURE; #89/850(a)).
toolOutcomeClasses.unresolvedOrUnknown: A tool_use without a tool_result; a duplicate or orphan tool_result; no result or more than one result; a result_index gap; SIGTERM/143 or any signal; result subtype != success; success with is_error:true; success without structured_output; aborted assistant; malformed/partial/oversized frame; invalid UTF-8; duplicate JSON keys; an unknown message type/subtype off the reviewed allowlist. All reject a successful proposal; never relabel as ordinary failure (source: #94/879 UNRESOLVED/UNKNOWN).
toolOutcomeClasses.policyOrFatal: POLICY: any result.permission_denials entry or system/permission_denied event (rule/mode/classifier/prompt-less deny), any tool_use for a tool outside the roster, any denied or declined StructuredOutput. permission_denials is the SOURCE-DEFINED denial form for this harness, answering #89/850(b). FATAL: startup error, auth error (assistant.error authentication_failed/oauth_org_not_allowed/billing_error/account_on_hold), model_not_found, apiKeySource != 'none', provider != firstParty, a modelUsage key != the requested model (fallback), a changed claude_code_version. All reject; no model assertion can erase them (source: #94/879 POLICY and FATAL; #94/880 FK5(h); #89/850(b)).
toolOutcomeClasses.classificationAuthority: Source-bound observed stream outcomes, not model prose; a failed tool_result alone is not an action-failure verdict (reused by reference from acceptance/subscription/manifest.json protocol.toolOutcomeClasses.classificationAuthority; #89/850).
toolOutcomeClasses.mandatoryChecks: An unresolved mandatory host-check failure or blocking finding prevents delivery until independently resolved for current inputs; a proposal or later successful diagnostic is not that receipt (reused by reference).

informationalOnly: todo/plan task state: mirrors the amended subscription rule (#93) — plan/todo state is informational, never evidence, and no plan/todo-complete predicate is a success barrier; planned-work verification rests on the observed stream history, the staged diff and independent host checks
total_cost_usd: a client ESTIMATE, never a provider receipt or budget control
--max-budget-usd is never passed: a client estimate, not a subscription control

budget.reference: docs/coordinator.md section 'Direct-harness subscription budget mode (Taskbot #90)' and acceptance/subscription/manifest.json budget block. Thresholds, planning charges, stop-between-actions, recovery_required for a successful action with unresolved usage, CI-reserve independence and overrun retention are NOT restated here and are not forked; this contract only defines the Claude Code adapter mapping.
budget.usageSource: result.modelUsage from the single terminal result; per-message assistant usage and result.usage (main loop only) are NOT the action total

adapterMapping.reported: sum modelUsage per model of inputTokens + outputTokens; cacheReadInputTokens/cacheCreationInputTokens and thinkingTokens are subsets or separate components and are NEVER added twice; outputTokens already includes thinking. Every modelUsage key must equal the requested model and every provider must be firstParty, else the run is fatal before usage mapping (source: #94/879 usage note).
adapterMapping.ambiguous-zero: all-zero modelUsage totals or absent modelUsage on an otherwise complete run
adapterMapping.unknown: interrupted/truncated telemetry, a zeroed crash or fatal-startup result, SIGTERM with no result, or any unresolved lifecycle; a claimed success with unresolved usage keeps the existing unknown-success barrier and does not adopt a head (coordinator.md #90 semantics, by reference)
adapterMapping.localNoModel: local (non-agent) actions report local-no-model zero per the referenced mode; a Claude Code launch is never a local action

budget.totalCostUsd: client estimate only; NEVER a provider receipt, never merged into budgets.harnessReportedTokens

requirements.gate: Pinned Claude Code 2.1.283 build identity: absolute versioned binary path, host-measured sha256/size/buildTime, rehash at guarded start C1; the ~/.local/bin symlink, Homebrew 2.1.236, other installed versions and any hash mismatch are rejected; a missing binary makes the profile unavailable, never substituted; bundle strings are not reproducible-build attestation (source: #94/872 F1; #94/880 G-VERSION).

Subscription OAuth is the only auth and Rocky never reads/copies/symlinks/proxies credentials: dedicated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolation (mode H1), sealed positive env allowlist, regression-asserted forbidden env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, provider switches, token/FD/gateway/profile/managed-path vars, CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE), no --bare/apiKeyHelper/settings-env route, post-run init.apiKeySource=='none' and provider=='firstParty' as nonsecret signals only — every one of these protections remains REQUIRED. Gate G-KC (model-reachable keychain) is decided: the user ACCEPTED the residual risk 2026-09-28 (#95/883, mirrored #1/884), recorded as an explicit user-accepted visible limitation, not a qualified containment claim; no separate macOS user, no probe required before proceeding (N03 is OPTIONAL defense-in-depth), revisit on a shared/multi-user host; the shell-bearing implementer profile no longer waits on G-KC and remains blocked only by its other honest gates (G-SET, G-MANAGED, G-HOME, G-INIT-VALUES, G-MODEL) and separately granted native/live authority (decision D-15) (source: #94/872 F2-F5; #94/878 section C; #94/880 G-KC/G-HOME/G-RACE).

Exact headless argv: every option one --opt=value element (variadic-swallow safe), the pinned flag order, --permission-mode=dontAsk with --permission-prompts=none, role tool rosters (implementer Bash/Read/Edit/Write/Glob/Grep; reviewer Read/Glob/Grep plus --restricted and no --add-dir), the fixed disallowedTools deny list, and pre-spawn rejection of every never-pass flag and off-table model/effort (source: #94/878 sections A/D; #94/878 F9).

Discovery sealing: --setting-sources= empty, Rocky-owned canonical --settings with allowlisted keys only and producer rejection of prohibited keys (env, apiKeyHelper, *Helper, hooks, mcpServers, model*, fallbackModel, plugins...), hooks/skills/plugins/subagents/MCP/auto-memory/claude.ai-connectors/background-tasks off via the pinned controls, staged tree and every ancestor free of CLAUDE*.md/AGENTS.md/.claude/.mcp.json, managed/MDM/server-managed layers inventoried by hash with any presence refusing the profile, and post-run inventory rehash where drift makes the result unknown; the silently-ignored-invalid-settings behavior stays gated by G-SET (source: #94/872 F6-F8; #94/879 producer contract; #94/880 FK8/NP1/NP4, G-MANAGED/G-SET/G-CLAUDEMD-MANAGED). Native confirmations (R1 #108, zero-turn, #110/R3): a hostile SessionStart hook EXECUTES pre-auth with NO model turn — hook_started/hook_response frames, sentinel written inside the synthetic temp root (CC-P6 i, PASS) — so disableAllHooks:true + empty --setting-sources + the hostile-config discovery refusals are LOAD-BEARING, not belt-and-braces; the discovery refusals themselves were observed named and pre-spawn with zero spawn and the sentinel untouched (CC-P1, PASS: claude-config-dir-forbidden / claude-instruction-files-present / claude-managed-layer-present); and the G-SET silent-ignore direction is confirmed Direction B (CC-P3, PASS — effectiveness closure still requires CC-L2) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P6/verdict.md, CC-P1/verdict.md, CC-P3/verdict.md).

requirements.reusesConcept: S06/S07 and the accepted duplex/attempted-before-IO semantics (by reference; not forked)
requirements.gate: Exact immutable prompt bytes written once then a single EOF, <= min(config, 10 MB); BOM/invalid-UTF-8/empty/whitespace-only/over-limit rejected before spawn; durable attempted-before-IO intent with no resend after ambiguity; consumption evidenced only by system/init; a child that exits before reading leaves the attempt attempted-unknown (source: #94/878 F12, section E; #94/880 FK4).

Bounded strict NDJSON stream contract: incremental strict UTF-8, complete newline-delimited objects, finite byte/frame/line limits, duplicate-key rejection; exactly one system/init first with the identity conjunction; unique tool_use ids each with exactly one later matching tool_result; exactly one result with no result_index gap; frames after result, unknown types/subtypes off the reviewed allowlist, partial last lines, oversize and invalid encoding all reject; bounded raw capture precedes strict decoding (source: #94/879 F14/F15, COMPLETE and UNRESOLVED classes).

requirements.reusesConcept: S04 (by reference); final schema reused from acceptance/subscription/final.schema.json
requirements.gate: Structured final: inline canonical-minified --json-schema request implemented as the synthetic StructuredOutput tool_use/tool_result pair; the inline value is the #111 draft-07 wire projection of the frozen 2020-12 schema (semantically identical body; pinned projection hash; fail-closed dialect guard) because the pinned 2.1.283 validator rejects the frozen IRI at startup (source: R1 #108 CC-P5 + zero-turn diagnostic); result.structured_output REQUIRED for success — success without it is failure; error_max_structured_output_retries rejects; the host always re-validates against the full protected FROZEN schema and action/input/role binding; the schema flag is a request, never evidence (source: #94/878 F10, section F).

Outcome classification exactly as bound in protocol.toolOutcomeClasses: COMPLETE conjunction for a protocol-successful proposal; settled ordinary tool failures (is_error tool_result absent from permission_denials, including sandbox denials surfacing as ordinary Bash output) do not alone reject a later correctly bound proposal; result.permission_denials is the authoritative source-defined denial record (answering #89/850(b) for this harness) and any denial, off-roster tool_use or declined StructuredOutput rejects; unresolved lifecycles reject; auth/provider/model-fallback/version-drift observations are fatal (source: #94/879 classes; #89/850(a)/(b)).

Exit codes and cancellation: exit code alone is never success evidence (exit 0 with no result happens; exit 1 tracks only last-result is_error or permanent transport closure); SIGTERM to the owned group exits 143 with no result and classifies unknown; no interrupt acknowledgement is ever claimed; stdout EOF, stderr EOF, exit and independent owned physical quiescence are recorded separately; a late result after cancel is ignored; SIGINT behavior is unobserved and cancellation is SIGTERM-only until G-SIGINT closes (source: #94/879 F16, producer contract 4; #94/880 FK7, G-SIGINT).

requirements.reusesConcept: S08 and docs/coordinator.md #90 subscription-observed-v1 usage schema 2 (by reference; not forked)
requirements.gate: Usage mapping: only result.modelUsage feeds the harness-reported total (inputTokens+outputTokens per model; cache read/creation and thinking subsets never double-counted); positive valid numbers are reported, never established actual consumption; all-zero or absent telemetry is ambiguous-zero; interrupted/truncated/zeroed-crash telemetry is unknown; total_cost_usd and num_turns are informational and never receipts; threshold/stop/recovery semantics are exactly the referenced #90 mode (source: #94/879 usage note; #94/880 FK6).

requirements.reusesConcept: S04/S08/S10 and the #93-amended todo/plan rule (by reference)
requirements.gate: Informational-only surfaces: todo/plan task state is never evidence and no plan-complete predicate is a success barrier (mirrors the amended subscription contract); effort is requested-only and not echoed; the served model comes from modelUsage/assistant.message.model; the model's final is a proposal that can never establish head adoption, host checks, CI, review or delivery authority (source: #94/878 F11; #94/879 runtime metadata sources; acceptance/subscription/README.md as amended by #93).

Producer lifecycle and binding: checkpoints C0 (prepare/render/bundleDigest) through C5 (exit/signal, both EOFs, group quiescence, post-run inventory and configDir-children rehash) mirroring the accepted #92 C0-C5 shape; durable start intent before spawn; at most one spawn per action; admission rechecks lease/fence/deadline, binary hash and inventory inside the guarded start; prohibited combinations rejected before spawn; one-byte drift between C0 and C1 yields zero spawn; drift during the run makes the result unknown (source: #94/879 producer contract 1-5; #94/880 FK1/FK8).

openGates.severity: DECIDED — user-accepted limitation (no longer blocking; implementer still blocked by its other honest gates)
openGates.gate: The user decision on G-KC is recorded: risk ACCEPTED by the user 2026-09-28 (#95/883, mirrored #1/884; decision D-15 per review #96 B-01). Seatbelt allows SecurityServer/securityd.xpc mach-lookup, sandbox default reads cover the whole disk with no credential deny list, and Bash deny rules are bypassable, so a model shell may read the subscription OAuth keychain item without a prompt; no static proof either way, and this residual stays carried as an explicit user-accepted visible limitation for the final report, NOT a qualified containment claim. Accepted terms: no separate macOS user account; no probe required before proceeding — N03 remains OPTIONAL defense-in-depth evidence, never a blocking prerequisite; all other protections remain required; revisit if the deployment moves to a shared/multi-user host. Consequence: the implementer profile no longer waits on G-KC; it remains blocked by its OTHER honest gates (G-SET, G-MANAGED, G-HOME, G-INIT-VALUES, G-MODEL) and separately granted native/live authority. The reviewer role (no shell) avoids the path entirely (source: #94/872 F5; #94/880).

-p silently ignores settings files that fail validation and the effective sandbox state is unobservable in the stream; needs NP4 proof plus a per-run positive-control strategy or accepted qualification binding (source: #94/872 F6; #94/880). OBSERVED (partial, R1 #108 CC-P3, PASS, zero-turn): DIRECTION B natively confirmed — invalid --settings (unknown key; malformed JSON) is SILENTLY IGNORED, producing a byte-identical auth-failure frame sequence to the valid baseline, zero turns. Consequence: the shipped fail-closed pre-spawn validateClaudeSettingsBytes validation is evidence-bound MANDATORY, not optional hardening. The gate stays OPEN: effectiveness closure (proof the sandbox is actually effective when settings are valid, plus the per-run positive-control strategy) still requires CC-L2 (LIVE, NOT run) via N04 (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P3/verdict.md; #108 root triage comment 972; #110/R3).

Server-managed settings for Team/Enterprise OAuth are fetched remotely and cannot be disabled or inspected nonsecretly; account plan unknown (Pro/Max => not fetched [D]); endpoint managed absent at research time (names-only check) and re-inventoried each run (source: #94/880). OBSERVED (partial, R1 #108 CC-P1, PASS): the real host managed/MDM layers were re-inventoried on the probe host and are ALL ABSENT (lstat names-only; contents never read), and the shipped discovery refusal claude-managed-layer-present fires pre-spawn against a synthetic present layer (zero spawn). The per-run presence-refusal requirement is UNCHANGED; server-managed remote fetch remains uninspectable nonsecretly and the gate stays open (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P1/verdict.md; #110/R3).
Keychain search-list resolution when HOME != real home (H1), dedicated-config /login UX, refresh behavior, and whether USER must match; synthetic-only closure (source: #94/880).

Shared-home mode H2 would make the user's interactive sessions and Rocky share one keychain entry, refresh, ~/.claude.json and ~/.claude writes, with residual refresh-token rotation races unproven either way. This contract REJECTS H2 (decision D-04, dedicated mode H1 only), which avoids most of the race; the gate is carried because the residual is unproven and any future H2 profile must close it first (source: #94/880).

What the CLI writes into configDir despite --no-session-persistence (.claude.json, caches, statsig/growthbook, plugin cache, debug) and during auth refresh; inventory before/after on the synthetic dir (source: #94/878 F13; #94/880). OBSERVED (partial, R1 #108 CC-P5 sub-finding 1, PASS-quality; corroborated by the #111 native probe): unauth startup in a synthetic dedicated CFG gained .claude.json, backups/ (with .claude.json.backup.<ts>) and sessions/ DESPITE --no-session-persistence and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING=1; every gain bounded inside the synthetic CFG (temp root); the private synthetic HOME gained none; the empty-input pre-spawn refusal (prompt-empty) produced zero writes. The gate stays OPEN for auth-refresh writes, caches/statsig/plugin/debug surfaces under LIVE authority and any keychain interaction (CC-L0/CC-L1, NOT run) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P5/verdict.md; .qualification/claude-code-contract-95-amend-pfc1-111/native-probe/verdict.md; #110/R3).

The pinned binary was installed by auto-update on the research day; the user's own sessions may auto-update and prune older version files; Rocky's runs set DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER/DISABLE_UPDATES but cannot stop the user's. C1 rehash plus missing-binary => unavailable; bundle strings != reproducible build (source: #94/880).

Exact init tools/skills/slash_commands/mcp_servers values under this profile, including whether StructuredOutput appears in tools and whether --restricted composes with explicit --tools, are [P] (source: #94/880). PARTIALLY OBSERVED (zero-turn, unauth — NOT proven, NOT adapter-constrained): (1) R1 #108 CC-P6 addendum — a BARE-ARGV Tier-B init frame echoed model 'claude-sonnet-4-5', permissionMode 'default', the full DEFAULT tool roster, mcp_servers [] and the full slash_commands list: this is the native DEFAULT init shape under bare argv, and the echoed model is the accepted REQUEST, not proof of resolvability (auth failed immediately, zero turn). (2) #111 native probe — an init frame under the adapter-sealed env with the projected-schema argv SUBSET (-p --output-format=stream-json --verbose --input-format=text --json-schema=<projected> --model; the subset carried no --tools/--permission-mode/--setting-sources) shows StructuredOutput PRESENT in init.tools alongside the DEFAULT roster, permissionMode 'default', zero-turn. The research [P] honesty items H-01/H-02 are therefore PARTIALLY OBSERVED (citations above), not proven: exact init values under the adapter-constrained full profile (role roster, dontAsk, --restricted composition) remain gated to CC-L1 (LIVE, NOT run) and N02/L03 (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P6/verdict.md ADDENDUM; .qualification/claude-code-contract-95-amend-pfc1-111/native-probe/probe-stdout.log + verdict.md; #110/R3).

SIGINT frames and exit code unobserved; cancellation is SIGTERM-only, which is honest unknown (source: #94/880). STILL UNKNOWN — now WITH OBSERVATION (R1 #108 CC-P6 ii/iii, PASS): the scheduled signals were NEVER DELIVERED to a live process because unauth claude auth-failed in ~250-260 ms, preempting the T+8s SIGINT and the T+10s SIGTERM (signalsSent=[]); the FK7/F12 SIGTERM 143-no-result shape is likewise natively unobserved. Closure for both signal shapes requires a live model turn (CC-L3, LIVE, NOT run) (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P6/verdict.md; #110/R3).

api_retry-then-success acceptance is decided (D-05: accepted, recorded), but whether a model fallback without --fallback-model can occur (managed/server-side) stays open; detection is via modelUsage keys (source: #94/880).
Effort is not echoed, so it is requested-only; whether effort is actually applied needs the L04 policy decision (source: #94/880).
Whether CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS suppresses a managed CLAUDE.md is undocumented; irrelevant while managed is absent; inventoried (source: #94/880).

Anthropic's default system prompt is version-bound and not hashable by Rocky except through the version pin; replacement via --system-prompt(-file) was considered and rejected (decision D-06) (source: #94/880).

Research requested the exact full model IDs for the role table from #95/#90 and recorded only an example (claude-opus-5-5/high); the approved role table must be frozen in run config before admission, and the served ID always comes from modelUsage/assistant.message.model (source: #94/878 section A). ENUMERATION HALF PARTIALLY SATISFIED (R1 #108 CC-P8, PASS, static): a bounded read-only hashed grep of the pinned 2.1.283 bundle yielded 99 refined candidate model IDs (opus 37 / sonnet 37 / haiku 17 / instant 3 / legacy 5; .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P8/refined-model-candidates.json). These are BUNDLE STRINGS, NOT runtime-attested; resolvability of ANY candidate (including role-table models) is established only by CC-L1 modelUsage/assistant.message.model (LIVE, NOT run) or stays open. Per the user scope decision #1 2026-09-29 (c) (recorded as 'user decision c' in the #105 plan authority, comments 955/957), model IDs stay configurable and the role table is host-frozen: the approved role table must still be frozen in run config before admission. The gate stays OPEN (source: .qualification/native-probes-R1/probes/CC-P8/verdict.md; #110/R3).
